claim: A house states whether its till prices include tax, once, with who and when (lane 1 of the tax-inclusive decision; founder 2026-10-12, sim ledger S218, F1 BUILD IT). Migration house_tax_basis_and_rates adds restaurants.tax_basis TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unset', CHECKed to the four states unset / prices_include_tax / prices_exclude_tax / not_vat_charging, plus tax_basis_confirmed_by (public.users, RESTRICT) and tax_basis_confirmed_at, with a CHECK that unset carries no confirmation and every answer carries both, and a trigger refusing a changed basis under the old confirmation moment. No answer is defaulted and nothing reads country. Behaviour: supabase/tests/<version>_house_tax_basis_and_rates_test.sql T1-T2 (PGlite, full corpus PASS, control FAIL) and apps/api-gateway/src/common/tax-basis.spec.ts (vocabulary parity). This verify fails on 3a91de4a8 (no such migration).

claim: A house's tax rates are kept by business date, versioned per house and append-only, and the table is locked down in the migration that creates it (F-1537, founder F1). public.house_tax_rates holds restaurant_id, key_kind (house / pos_category / house_item), key, rate (a fraction, 0 <= rate < 1; NULL withdraws the key), effective_from (date, NOT NULL), effective_to (exclusive, after effective_from), version (assigned by a BEFORE INSERT trigger as the house's next number under a per-house lock; UNIQUE per house) and created_by. UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE are refused except the cascade from the house being deleted. RLS is enabled, the only policy is service_role, and anon/authenticated are revoked: the gateway scopes every statement to the house on the token. Behaviour: the pgtest T3-T4. This verify fails on 3a91de4a8.

claim: A POS check records the subtotal as the till sent it and the basis it was written under, and nothing already stored is rewritten (F-1537; founder 2026-10-12 S218 F2 ONLY FROM NOW, no backfill). pos_checks gains gross_subtotal numeric(12,2), tax_basis (NULL or one of the four house states) and tax_rate_version (only on a prices_include_tax row), all with no default, so every check written before reads NULL: the switch is marked by the rows. The migration issues no UPDATE or DELETE of pos_checks. Behaviour: the pgtest T5. This verify fails on 3a91de4a8.

claim: A recorded cost says whether tax is inside it, and loses that when the figure changes unstated (F-620; founder 2026-10-12 S218 F3 STAMP COST BASIS: margins go pre-tax only when cost is proven pre-tax). procurement_order_items.price_tax_basis, inventory_lots.unit_cost_tax_basis and restaurant_inventory.last_purchase_price_tax_basis are NULL (not stated) or includes_tax / excludes_tax, with no default and no backfill. One trigger function clears the basis when a cost figure changes in a write that leaves the basis as it was (attached to all three tables); a lot inserted from an order takes its line's basis when every same-house line for the item states the same one. inventory_lot_rollup appends wac_pre_tax_qty and wac_tax_included_qty over exactly the lots wac averages, and keeps security_invoker. Behaviour: the pgtest T6-T7; six migration mutants killed by it (2026-10-12). This verify fails on 3a91de4a8.
